text_blocks.snippet: Vista most commonly refers to a distant view or a wide panoramic landscape seen through an opening or from a high place.
snippet_highlighted_words: a distant view or a wide panoramic landscape seen through an opening or from a high place

text_blocks.snippet: Because the word is used in many different contexts, it can also refer to several famous places, programs, and products.

list.snippet: Definition: A broad, sweeping view or a mental outlook on the future.
Vista, California: A medium-sized city in San Diego County, California, located about seven miles inland from the Pacific Ocean.
The Vista (Columbia, South Carolina): A popular arts, dining, and entertainment district in the heart of Columbia, South Carolina.
Windows Vista: A major release of the Microsoft Windows operating system that followed Windows XP in 2007.
AmeriCorps VISTA: A national service program in the United States designed to fight poverty through community-based volunteering.
VistA (Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture): The electronic health record system used by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.
Vista Equity Partners: A major American investment firm that focuses on software, data, and technology-enabled businesses.
